original_title: The Jury Has Spoken, American Films Shut Out, But What Does It All  Mean For Oscar? – Cannes Film Festival
summary_en: With the exception of a shared Best Director win (with La Bola Negra) for Fatherland, as well as a Best Actress win for the two stars of All Of A Sudden, the jury of the 79th Cannes Film Festival decided that there was not much to reward in the fest’s first six days. Instead the […]
